premise: The free Greenhouse activation course. Seven of Jason's strongest foundational lessons that take a fence-sitter from 'I could never afford this' to 'I have a first step I can take this week.' This is the magic-moment mini-course: short, finishable, and designed to convert a lurker into someone who has actually decided to start. Reframes affordability, kills the savings myth, gives the land-buying hack, and sets the systems order so the new homesteader never freezes.

lessons.title: How Do You Afford Off Grid Living?
lessons.why: Opens by dissolving the #1 blocker: reframes affordability as cost-of-living comparison, not capital you must save up. The mindset unlock that makes every later lesson usable.

lessons.title: How Much Money Should I Have Saved Before I Go Off Grid?
lessons.why: Kills the 'wait until I have $X saved' trap directly. Removes the most common reason people never start.

lessons.title: The Self Sufficiency Mistake Most Homesteaders Make
lessons.why: Reframes self-sufficiency as an incremental journey, not all-or-nothing. Lowers the bar to entry so beginners give themselves permission to start small.

lessons.title: The First Thing To Do If You Want To Start An Off Grid Homestead
lessons.why: Counter-intuitive truth that buying land is NOT step one; gives the pre-purchase prep sequence so the beginner has a concrete first action this week.

lessons.title: How We Turned -$27 Into 3 Acres Of Off Grid Land In 34 Days
lessons.why: The proof-of-concept story plus the 3-step owner-finance acquisition method. Most motivating, most actionable single lesson Jason has on land.

lessons.title: Setting Up Your Homestead: What Systems In What Order
lessons.why: Gives the sequencing framework so the new owner installs systems in the right order and the land works for them. The spine of the entire pipeline.

lessons.title: Out of the Box Thinking Off Grid
lessons.why: Closes the free course with the core resourcefulness mindset (scan environment, ask 'how can I'). The attitude that makes a broke start survivable and the natural bridge into paid material.

notes: Strongest free activation sequence: 3 mindset unlocks, then 4 concrete first steps. Every lesson is 'lesson'-actionability and foundational. Intentionally ends on the resourcefulness mindset to hand off into the paid Resourcefulness and Land courses.

course_title: Buy Land Broke: The Owner-Finance Playbook
premise: A tight, self-contained course on acquiring off-grid land with little-to-no money and no bank. Covers owner financing, tax auctions, what to look for, the mistakes that sink broke buyers, and the HOA/POA and farm-vs-homestead distinctions that waste people's time. This is the single most-requested, most-searched topic Jason has, and it stands alone as a paid product.

lessons.title: The most important thing you need to move off grid
lessons.why: Establishes that LOW cost, not big budget, is the real prerequisite. Frames the whole course.

lessons.title: How Much Does it Cost to Live Off Grid?
lessons.why: Gives the monthly cost comparison method so the buyer knows what they're actually solving for before shopping.

lessons.title: How to Buy Off Grid Land Even If You Don't Have A Lot Of Money
lessons.why: The farm-vs-homestead land distinction stops buyers searching the wrong listings. Must come before any platform lesson.

lessons.title: A Great Place To Find Cheap Owner Financed Land
lessons.why: Names a specific platform and how to use it safely. Concrete sourcing action.

lessons.title: The Cheapest Way To Buy Land For Off-Grid Living
lessons.why: Adds the tax-auction channel for the deepest discounts. Second sourcing method widens the playbook.

lessons.title: 5 States Where Off Grid Living Is Practically Free in 2025
lessons.why: Geographic shortlist with land prices and rent-vs-buy math so the buyer narrows where to look.

lessons.title: How to Buy Land When You're Broke (The Owner Finance Hack)
lessons.why: Core mechanics of owner financing and the trade-offs to watch. The heart of the course.

lessons.title: How We Turned -$27 Into 3 Acres Of Off Grid Land In 34 Days
lessons.why: The full 3-step process with a real platform and $300 down. Turns theory into a repeatable sequence.

lessons.title: Starting Off Grid This Year? Do This First
lessons.why: Step-by-step low-down-payment, low-monthly entry path. Ties financing into an actual buy plan.

lessons.title: Buying Cheap Land - AVOID THESE MISTAKES
lessons.why: The 5 biggest broke-buyer mistakes, especially when skipping bank and realtor. Protective lesson before they commit money.

lessons.title: What To Look For When Searching For Off Grid Land
lessons.why: Evaluation framework that prevents analysis paralysis in a rising market. Part 1 of his land-search series.

lessons.title: Cari Ambushed Me To Get These Answers For You!!
lessons.why: HOA/POA evaluation framework for raw land. The legal gotcha most beginners miss; good capstone.

lessons.title: I Was Scared of This Too — So I Looked It Up
lessons.why: Property-tax 'you never really own it' myth-busted with belief-vs-fact distinction. Removes the last emotional blocker before buying.

notes: CHALLENGE CANDIDATE: the Find Cheap Land + Finance It modules (7 videos on one self-contained system) are a perfect 14-day paid challenge — 'Find and make an offer on owner-financed land in 14 days.' Test demand here before committing to the full drip. -yt630ot7qE (Off Grid Reality Check, land financing Part 2) and _hYJ_rXCoRU (Buy Land With Very Little Money) are strong alternates/overflow if any lesson underperforms.

premise: The complete beginner-to-installed solar course: understand the four components, size your system correctly, then wire and ground it safely without paying an installer $15-20k. Sequenced from concept to live array. Jason has more genuinely teachable solar lessons than any other topic, and this is the highest-value paid technical course in the catalog.

lessons.title: The Components of an Off Grid Solar Array
lessons.why: Plain-language breakdown of the four core parts (panel, charge controller, battery, inverter). The vocabulary every later lesson assumes.

lessons.title: Adding Solar To Your Off Grid Homestead
lessons.why: Places solar in the systems order-of-operations and frames budget planning. Sets expectations before spending.

lessons.title: How Much Solar Will You Need To Live Off Grid?
lessons.why: The amps x volts = watts sizing method plus the 30% compressor duty-cycle rule. The single most important calculation in the course.

lessons.title: I Built You A Tool To Make Solar Design Simple (And Free)
lessons.why: Walks through the free in-community solar designer tool to size a system in 5 minutes. Drives Greenhouse users into the community while delivering real value.

modules.module_title: Choose Your Components on a Budget

lessons.title: DIY Off Grid Solar and the Cost
lessons.why: The full budget stack: used panels, marine batteries, hybrid inverter + generator, with real cost breakdowns.

lessons.title: The True Cost Of Off Grid Solar
lessons.why: DIY-under-$5k vs $15-20k installer math plus honest performance trade-offs. Justifies doing it yourself.

lessons.title: Testing The Ampeak 3000w Inverter On an Off Grid Solar Array
lessons.why: How to evaluate and pick a budget pure-sine inverter. Concrete component-selection decision.

lessons.title: How to Make DIY Solar Safe and Easy
lessons.why: Safety protocols and the industry secret that makes self-install viable. Gatekeeper lesson before any wiring.

lessons.title: DIY Solar Panel Installation 4 SunGold 590w Full Process
lessons.why: Full replicable install with DIY salvaged-lumber racking. The first hands-on build step.

lessons.title: Making Electrical Connections Safely on Your DIY Off Grid Solar Array
lessons.why: Specific connectors and safety practices to avoid shock or damage. Core wiring lesson.

lessons.title: The Final DC Connections on a DIY Off Grid Solar Array
lessons.why: Completing DC wiring and series connections, with common-mistake avoidance. Brings the array near-live.

lessons.title: Remember This Step on Your Off Grid DIY Solar Build
lessons.why: The four grounding-rod methods with honest trade-offs. The step beginners forget; strong capstone.

notes: CHALLENGE CANDIDATE: the Understand + Size It Right modules (4 videos) make a great low-stakes 14-day 'Design your off-grid solar system' challenge that funnels into the free designer tool and the community. 4nkt8HjTXXE (Scrap Solar Tracker / solar series kickoff) and OFrqbN9HMBQ (What We Use for Our Array) are good bonus/show-and-tell lessons; the Part 1-14 chicken-coop-into-solar-array montage videos are NOT lessons (see unplaced).

course_title: Homestead Economics: Escape the Wage Trap
premise: The financial-philosophy course that powers the whole Rock Rich worldview: why the conventional save-til-65 path is rigged, why your time and skills are your real assets, and how to build income as a homestead system instead of chasing a paycheck. Mindset-heavy but every lesson contains a usable reframe. This is the course that converts a viewer into a believer who buys land.

lessons.title: Your Hourly Wage is a Trap (Homestead Economics)
lessons.why: Time-as-asset framing: trading hours for wages is selling your scarcest asset cheap. The thesis statement of the course.

lessons.title: Off-Grid Homestead Dreams? The Latte Lie Keeping You Broke
lessons.why: Skills-over-savings philosophy; exposes how systemic debt design keeps people stuck. Reframes where wealth actually comes from.

lessons.title: The Problem With Dave Ramsey
lessons.why: Counters the most popular conventional advice with cut-dependency-now. Earns trust by taking on a sacred cow.

lessons.title: Affording Off Grid Living and This DOGE Thing
lessons.why: Dependency-vs-independence financial framework tied to current events. Makes the case personal and timely.

lessons.title: Forget Retirement—Build This Instead
lessons.why: The Rock Rich retirement framework: land + skills + systems replacing a 401k. The constructive payoff of the course.

lessons.title: How We Make Money On Our Off Grid Homestead
lessons.why: Money-as-variable framework and permanent-vs-temporary fixes. Bridges philosophy into income mechanics.

lessons.title: 3 Smart Ways to Make Money on Your Off-Grid Homestead
lessons.why: Three concrete income streams a homesteader can start this week. The most actionable income lesson.

lessons.title: How to Develop an Income Living Off Grid
lessons.why: Treats income as part of the build order, not a separate problem. Integrates earning into the systems mindset and closes the course.

notes: Heavily 'rockrich'/'financial' angle — this is the course most likely to convert free members to paid because it sells the worldview, not just a skill. -yt630ot7qE and vdl0euB7hLg are cost-breakdown overflow if a lesson needs replacing.

course_title: The Resourcefulness Engine: Build With What You Have
premise: Jason's signature mindset made teachable: how to solve homestead problems with scavenged materials, leverage, and the simplest-viable-solution-first principle instead of money. Pairs the philosophy with a few clean hands-on builds (rock moving, lava-rock oven, welding) so members produce something real. This is the soul of Rock Rich turned into skills.

lessons.title: Out of the Box Thinking Off Grid
lessons.why: Scavenger resourcefulness mindset: scan your environment, ask 'how can I.' The foundational reframe.

lessons.title: The Right Way to do Things Off Grid
lessons.why: On-hand-materials problem solving: use what you have before spending. Reinforces and operationalizes the mindset.

lessons.title: A Frugal Project and What's Most Important
lessons.why: Makes frugality the foundational skill and shows simplest-viable-solution-first in practice. The discipline behind the mindset.

lessons.title: Big Ol' Rock Moving by Hand Made Easy
lessons.why: First-principles leverage method for moving big rocks by hand. The cleanest demonstration of simplest-viable-solution.

lessons.title: Rocks Get Sliced Up Like Butter Using This Tool
lessons.why: Turning irregular property rock into usable building material. Pairs naturally with the rock-moving lesson.

lessons.title: Epic DIY: Off-Grid Lava Rock Oven!
lessons.why: A full replicable no-budget build (4:1 sand/Portland mortar + volcanic rock). A finished tangible project for members.

lessons.title: Flux Core Welding Not MIG! Continuous Stick Welding Explained
lessons.why: Teaches flux-core vs MIG and the drag technique for clean welds. A genuinely transferable shop skill.

lessons.title: Sometimes The Best Therapy Is Fixing Something That Is Broken
lessons.why: The fix-one-thing reset method: when overwhelmed, complete one controllable repair. Ties the skills back to mindset and resilience as a closer.

notes: Strong 'system' / 'howto' blend. The hands-on builds give the course completion artifacts (an oven, a weld) which boosts completion rate. j9anNC_14II (DIY stovetop griddle) is a good bonus short if more build content is wanted.

course_title: Systems-First: Set Up Your Homestead in the Right Order
premise: The operations course. Once you have land, what do you build first, second, third — and what does everyone forget? Covers the homestead setup sequence (security, fire safety, income, waste, comfort) and the maintenance discipline that keeps it alive. Prevents the expensive, demoralizing mistake of building things in the wrong order.

lessons.title: Setting Up Your Homestead: What Systems In What Order
lessons.why: The master sequencing framework. The backbone the whole course hangs on.

lessons.title: This might be the most important step of all when setting up your off grid homestead
lessons.why: Extends the sequence through security, fire safety, income, into the enjoyment phase that makes it sustainable. The 'why you don't quit' step.

lessons.title: Creature Comforts on our Off Grid Homestead
lessons.why: Creature-comforts-first framework: set up power/water/tech before livestock and garden. A specific ordering rule beginners get backwards.

lessons.title: Security on your Off Grid Property is a must. Part 2
lessons.why: Security mindset and approach for remote property, born from losing a decade of progress to theft. First in the safety order.

lessons.title: Fire Safety on the Off Grid Homestead
lessons.why: Fire safety as the next priority after security. The second link in the safety order-of-operations.

lessons.title: Living Off Grid: What Everyone Forgets to Solve
lessons.why: Waste management (trash, gray water, human waste) — the closed-loop system nobody plans for. The 'forgot to solve it' lesson.

lessons.title: Off Grid Living And Homesteading Is A Trap || Rock Rich EP6
lessons.why: The maintenance-mindset shift: routine upkeep, not just projects, keeps a homestead alive. The discipline that prevents collapse and closes the course.

notes: CHALLENGE CANDIDATE: the Sequence + Solve-What-Everyone-Forgets modules (6 videos on one system — setup order) could run as a 14-day 'Plan your homestead build order' challenge. mUNkTiiIG3o (Three Mistakes That Guarantee Failure) is a strong alternate/opener if needed.

course_title: Build Skills, Not Fear: Resilience for an Uncertain Future
premise: The preparedness-and-resilience course, reframed away from doom and toward competence. The throughline: a tradeable skill is the most portable, durable asset you can own. Covers skill-building, the fear-to-competence ladder, the AI/job-displacement hedge, the go-bag minimum, and the fail-up iteration loop. Sells resilience without selling panic — on-brand for Jason's apolitical, calm voice.

lessons.title: Developing Skills For An Uncertain Future
lessons.why: Skill-first resilience: identify one tradeable skill and build it. The thesis lesson.

lessons.title: How To Fail Up: Earn a Skill
lessons.why: A skill is the most portable, durable asset — learn anything online, carry it anywhere. Reinforces the thesis with a concrete action.

lessons.title: Off Grid Homesteads, AI and Humanoid Robots
lessons.why: Manual skills + land ownership as the hedge against AI-driven job loss. Timely, motivating case for why to act now.

lessons.title: Preparing Is Not The Same As Living In Fear
lessons.why: The fear-to-competence skill stack and preparedness reframe. The emotional core of the course.

lessons.title: Emergency Sleeping Bag: Don't Get Caught Without One
lessons.why: The go-bag minimum — one cheap, concrete preparedness action anyone can take today. Grounds the philosophy in a do-it-now task.

lessons.title: How To Fail Up: Iterate Mistakes Into Wins
lessons.why: Fail-up loop: iterating through mistakes is the actual path to success. The practice that builds the skills, closing the course.

notes: Pulls together 'system' and 'mistakes' lessons under a calm, non-doom banner. JsBm6bdOfvY and 9JqohywOBm8 overlap thematically with the same 'tradeable skill' system — fine within one course, sequenced thesis then action.

course_title: Find Your People: Community and Family Off-Grid
premise: The relational course. Off-grid does not mean alone — and the social/family piece is what makes the lifestyle survivable long-term. Covers how to build real mutual-aid community, integrate into a rural town, win your partner over, and transition kids off screens into outdoor life. Often the missing piece that determines whether a family sticks with it.

lessons.title: How To Build Community Off Grid
lessons.why: Community-vs-population distinction and mutual-aid building. The foundational framework for the module.

lessons.title: Remember to Help People
lessons.why: Help-first community building from Jason's mentor. The single most actionable rule for making rural connections.

lessons.title: Off Grid Living And How To Get Along In A Small Community
lessons.why: Unwritten rules for integrating into a rural town as a city transplant. Prevents the social mistakes that isolate newcomers.

lessons.title: How do I 'convince' my significant other to go off grid with me?
lessons.why: Changing-minds sales framework for getting a partner on board. Solves the #1 relationship blocker to starting.

lessons.title: Off Grid Living, Screens and Your Kids
lessons.why: Screen-to-outdoors transition plan for kids. The practical family-logistics capstone that keeps the whole household bought in.

notes: Smaller (5 lessons) but tightly coherent and addresses real adoption blockers. Good cross-sell to anyone who finished the Land or Systems courses. Many community-themed videos (jYSnwUBYiqA, T4QAng5K_1A) are marketing assets for Rock Rich itself, not lessons — see unplaced.

course_title: Should You Go Off-Grid? An Honest Reality Check
premise: A short, free-adjacent decision course for the truly undecided. Busts the myths, shows the real costs and sacrifices, and helps the viewer honestly decide if off-grid is right for them BEFORE they spend a dollar. Acts as a top-of-funnel companion to the free Starting System — lower commitment, pure clarity.

lessons.title: 3 Myths About Off Grid Living
lessons.why: Busts three core misconceptions so bad info stops holding the viewer back. Clears the deck.

lessons.title: These Three Mistakes Guarantee Your Homestead Will Fail
lessons.why: The three mistakes that doom most attempts before they start. Honest pre-commitment warning.

lessons.title: How Much Does it Cost to Go Off Grid?
lessons.why: Realistic startup-cost breakdown that challenges the big-money myth. Grounds the decision in numbers.

lessons.title: How To Start Off Grid Living And Homesteading Right Now
lessons.why: Contrarian 'start now, don't wait to learn everything' advice. Converts an undecided viewer into someone ready for the Starting System course.

notes: Deliberately tiny and free. Designed as a sibling funnel to the Rock Rich Starting System. tCyhbpue0PM and 7d3sL4gQhjI are affordability overflow; many 'why off grid' videos are pure assets (see unplaced).
